Results.ReviewText:
The first grill I purchased was Weber, and I still have the rotisserie from when I bought it over 15 years ago. That one died, and I was so happy to purchase a new Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill last month. I love the grill, the flip-down shelf, and the fact that the propane tank is located on the side which makes it easy to see the level of gas and is easy to remove. 

However, there is one major flaw which makes it very difficult to manuever/move the grill.  The wheels are located on the side with the stable shelf. There should be some kind of handles installed by the flip/down shelf to grab when moving the grill. When the shelf is in the down position, the edges are very sharp. It takes 2 people on either side of the grill to move it. 

Another disappointment are the plastic wheels.  The first time I used the grill, the wheels came off!  I found the cotter pin and called the location I purchased the grill to help me in putting it back together (which was not easy).  The Weber Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill is a very solid construction ~ except for the plastic wheels and no handles to grab in order to move the grill.
Results.Title: Love the grill ~ but it is not easy to move around

Results.ReviewText: My first propane Weber. Love the grill, its features, and its sturdiness. It's obviously better than any other grill I've purchased and I wanted something that was going to last, cook evenly, and not wear out within 2 years. The only complaint I have is the regulator on my brand new grill leaked where it couples to the tank. The hissing was audible and I did the obligatory test with soapy water and, sure enough, bubbles formed. So, I called customer service, and after being on hold for 55 minutes, connected with a very nice representative who graciously offered to send a new one at no cost. After a few weeks of waiting, I finally went to my local hardware store and bought a universal regulator as I wasn't able to grill for weeks. The new regulator didn't leak and I was in business. Weber's replacement regulator finally arrived yesterday. I put it on today and the same hissing sound could be heard at the same spot. I'm puzzled and disappointed. I had to spend another $20 on a new regulator for a brand new Weber grill. Not what I expected.
Results.Title: Great grill - regulator issues

Results.ReviewText:
I have always been a charcoal user, and have enjoyed the convenience of of propane. It's nice to have the grill ready to use immediately.
I like the cast iron grates, and keeping the temperature regulated has been very easy compared to other gas grills that I've worked with in the past,
So far, my only complaints is that the red color was discontinued, and the iGrill3 has been underwhelming; it looses connection when I get more than 20 feet away from the grill.

I’d buy another today if I had to. Great grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Assembley was relatively easy. It would help if parts were labeled with #'s or letters corresponding to the pre assembly parts list. It should be noted when I connected the hose/regulator to the LP tank I heard a gas leak emanating from where the regulator met the tightening collar. There seemed to a little play or wobble. When I lifted the regulator slightly the leak stopped. I sent an email to customer service with my concern over the issue and had a response in less than 12 hours. No questions asked, I was told an order was placed for a replacement part on back order. When I returned from vacation a week later the part had arrived.  I appreciate the customer support! Haven't had too much time to experiment with the new grill except with some burgers, steaks and pork chops. The grill heats up quickly and cooks evenly. I am happy with my purchase thus far. I hope in the near future Webber could find a manufacturing plant in the USA!
Results.Title: WGM

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We grill all year around.  When we had to replace our old grill there was no question it would be another Weber.  We live in the Northeast US and the weather is not kind to a metal object that stays outside all the time.  I am confident that this Weber will outlast the previous one.  It is easy to use and the controls are precise.  From hot dogs to filet mignon, to fish filets, to steaks and chops, to chicken and, of course, hamburgers all are cooked easily and well on my Weber.  I couldn't be happier with our purchase.
Results.Title: This is my second Weber in the last 20 years.
